import subprocess
from unittest.mock import patch, MagicMock
import typer
import platform

def test_launch_url_wait_false():
    url = "http://example.com"
    
    # Mock platform to be Linux
    with patch("platform.system", return_value="Linux"), \
         patch("shutil.which", return_value=True), \
         patch("subprocess.Popen") as mock_popen:
        
        # Setup mock process
        mock_process = MagicMock()
        mock_process.wait.return_value = 0
        mock_popen.return_value = mock_process
        
        # Call launch with wait=False
        result = typer.launch(url, wait=False)
        
        # Verify result is 0
        assert result == 0
        # Verify wait() was NOT called
        mock_process.wait.assert_not_called()
        print("test_launch_url_wait_false passed")

def test_launch_url_wait_true():
    url = "http://example.com"
    
    # Mock platform to be Linux
    with patch("platform.system", return_value="Linux"), \
         patch("shutil.which", return_value=True), \
         patch("subprocess.Popen") as mock_popen:
        
        # Setup mock process
        mock_process = MagicMock()
        mock_process.wait.return_value = 42
        mock_popen.return_value = mock_process
        
        # Call launch with wait=True
        result = typer.launch(url, wait=True)
        
        # Verify result is 42
        assert result == 42
        # Verify wait() WAS called
        mock_process.wait.assert_called_once()
        print("test_launch_url_wait_true passed")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        test_launch_url_wait_false()
        test_launch_url_wait_true()
        print("All tests passed!")
    except AssertionError as e:
        print(f"Test failed: {e}")
        exit(1)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"An error occurred: {e}")
        exit(1)
